mailboxes.evidence: Seed creates Northwind Support, Northwind Billing, and Northwind Returns mailboxes.

agents.evidence: Seed creates three active agents: Mia Chen, Noah Patel, and Olivia Reed; Mia and Noah can delete conversations, and Noah has assigned-only visibility.

customers.evidence: Seed creates six customers with companies and distinctive email addresses.

conversations.evidence: Seed creates eight conversations with stable numbers 7001-7008 and fixed 2026 dates.

varied_statuses.evidence: Conversation counts are 3 active, 2 pending, 2 closed, and 1 spam.

visible_assertions.evidence: CLI verify checks DB counts and rendered mailbox list; browser-checker should confirm populated dashboard/list/detail visibility.

assigned-only-agent.evidence: Noah Patel has User::PERM_ONLY_ASSIGNED_TICKETS and can sign in with noah.patel@tester-env.local / TesterEnv123!.

assigned-search-fixtures.evidence: The term 'replacement' matches ticket 7001 assigned to Mia Chen and ticket 7008 assigned to assigned-only agent Noah Patel.

nonadmin-delete-permission.evidence: Mia Chen and Noah Patel have User::PERM_DELETE_CONVERSATIONS, so a non-admin agent can use conversation delete actions.

delete-forever-enabled.evidence: Admin Alex Admin has conversation delete policy access; seeded conversations can be moved to Deleted and permanently deleted after each reset.

cross-mailbox-agent-access.evidence: Mia Chen is assigned to Northwind Support ticket 7001 and has Support access, but she has no Northwind Returns mailbox access.

move-conversation-permission.evidence: Admin Alex Admin can move conversations between Northwind Support, Billing, and Returns; the seed includes all three mailboxes.

nonadmin-mailbox-signature-manager.evidence: Mia Chen has Northwind Support mailbox access with the signature-management permission.

number-id-mismatch.evidence: Visible ticket numbers are fixed at 7001-7008 while database ids are auto-incrementing internal ids, so numeric search ambiguity is observable.

mailboxes-nonalphabetical-creation.evidence: Mailboxes are created in Support, Billing, Returns order, which differs from alphabetical Billing, Returns, Support order.
